verdict.rationale: Factory documents integrations with Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab and Slack to 'keep development synchronized with team systems' and lets Software Factory filter work by these integrations, implying issues/tickets can feed into droid sessions, but there is no explicit documented workflow showing a developer clicking 'assign to droid' from within an issue/ticket UI. missing for 10: explicit doc/example of triggering a droid session directly from a Jira/Linear ticket, confirmation of automatic task creation from issue metadata, and independent/hands-on corroboration of this flow.
